# aidial_bucket (Data Source)

Looks up the bucket owned by the API key the provider is configured with.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resolves to the bucket owned by the configured api_key.
data "aidial_bucket" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `appdata` (String)
- `bucket` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
